rules.name: Use shared page-help chips and drawers
rules.statement: Membership, Beneficiary and Payment use the global PageHelp composition: PageHelpChips selects a source-authored topic and PageHelpDrawer displays its supplied title/content through AppDrawer. Page help topics, order, labels and titles come from each global page definition; shared topic renderers use the current effective content. Empty selections render no help. No page-specific wrapper owns chip selection or drawer state. All Health pages and supplied Health source-form previews show no page help chips. Menu tools and task drawers retain their shared AppDrawer shell and domain content.
